title: Buying a SEKA Exceed? (There’s something you need to know)

takeaways.text: From mid-2022, viewers who had paid deposits for Exceed framesets through the online retailer Cycling 100 told the presenter about long delays, slow replies and difficulty getting deposits back, though each case appeared to be resolved eventually.

A local friend of the presenter who paid a deposit got no answer to questions or to a refund request under the retailer's 30-day policy, while a sales enquiry sent under another name was answered quickly.
The refund arrived 8–10 weeks later, after the presenter intervened.
The retailer said its customer support had improved, but the presenter could no longer recommend buying through it.
The presenter still recommends the Exceed RDC frameset and, now that a hub issue has been resolved, the wheels supplied with it, suggesting other sales channels for both.

disclosure: The presenter was previously sponsored by the retailer he criticises here.
summary: A 2023 warning about the former online retailer of the SEKA Exceed, not about the frame.
